item.title: Charleston County seeks public input on draft 2026 Transportation Sales Tax program with online survey, community meetings
item.description: Charleston County is seeking public input on the proposed 2026 Transportation Sales Tax (TST) program, inviting residents across the county to review the updated draft plan and share feedback through an online survey and upcoming community meetings.

item.title: Party at the Point Announces 2026 Lineup
item.description: Party at The Point, the Happy Hour concert series, returns this April to the Charleston Harbor Resort and Marina in Mount Pleasant. Taking place Friday evenings from April 17 to July 17, 2026

item.title: Wilco to Perform at Firefly Distillery in July
item.description: Indie rock band Wilco will perform at Firefly Distillery on Friday, July 10, at 7 p.m. Fans can enjoy two full sets with one intermission for a night dedicated entirely to the group’s signature sound.

item.title: Battery open season against reigning champs Pittsburgh at home Saturday
item.description: The Charleston Battery are back in action on Saturday, March 7, to kick off the 2026 season against Pittsburgh Riverhounds SC. Kickoff at Patriots Point is set for 6 p.m. ET, and the match will stream for free on CBS Sports Golazo Network

item.title: Charleston Battery add Wayne, Rigsby, Held, Alexandre to 2026 roster
item.description: The Charleston Battery are pleased to announce the addition of players Jack Wayne, Cohen Rigsby, Kruz Held and Medgy Alexandre to the 2026 roster on Friday, pending league and federation approval.

item.title: Travel + Leisure Names Charleston One of the Best Beach Towns to Live in Year-round
item.description: Travel + Leisure recently shared the 15 Best U.S. Beach Towns to Live in Year-round, According to Real Estate Experts, and Charleston checked in at No. 10.

item.title: Target Launches New “Baby Boutique” Shopping Experience in Summerville
item.description: Parents across the Lowcountry will soon have a new way to shop for baby essentials as Target rolls out a redesigned baby shopping experience at select stores across the country, including one location serving the Charleston region.
